title: Financial Management for Partner Property Owners
summary: See how to manage financial reporting and payouts for partner property owners transparently.
body_markdown:
Financial management for partner property owners means each owner's revenue, expenses, and payout calculations connect to their specific properties, with scoped visibility into their own performance — instead of a manually compiled statement sent periodically. In **Jestor** , owner-facing financial data connects through the same structure used for portfolio-wide financial management.


Owner relationships in short-stay operations depend heavily on financial transparency — owners who don't trust the numbers, or who feel like they're waiting too long for statements, are more likely to end the partnership.


## What owner financial reporting struggles with manually


- Manually compiling each owner's statement from separate property data
- Delays between the reporting period ending and the owner actually receiving their statement
- Owners with no way to check their own property's status between statements
- Revenue-share calculations done manually, prone to error


## How structured owner financial management works


- Each property connects to its owner record and revenue-share terms
- Financial data updates live, connected to native **Omie** or **Conta Azul** integration
- Owners can be given scoped, permissioned access to their own property's data
- **AI** -generated reports can produce a styled, branded statement on demand


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Revenue-share calculations connect to live data, reducing manual error
- Scoped permissions let owners see their own performance without exposing the full portfolio
- On-demand AI-generated reports remove the delay of manual statement preparation
- Native ERP integration keeps the underlying financial data accurate


Manual owner reporting Structured owner financial management


Manually compiled statements Live, connected financial data


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can owners access their own property's financial data directly?** Yes, through scoped permissions limited to their own property. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does this calculate revenue-share splits automatically?** It can, based on the terms connected to the owner's contract.


**Can AI generate a styled statement for each owner?** Yes, through the AI-powered report generator.
